risks.risk: Unknown condition (possible internal damage, low compression, oil leaks, or missing components).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or compression test results) and a checklist photo showing all major components present (starter, alternator, sensors, harness connectors) with no missing parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case as not proven to work (assume needs overhaul/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or mismatched harness/sensors (common with engine assemblies sold as parts).
risks.proof: Photos of the engine with a parts list: show every sensor/connector and confirm what is included/excluded; include close-ups of connectors and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case as incomplete/needs parts to be fully usable.

risks.risk: Potential scam/overstatement of 'direct Korean parts' without proof of sourcing.
risks.proof: Provide invoice/receipt or supplier documentation showing the engine/part origin and part number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used engine assembly with no confirmed origin/brand.

Tell the exact vehicle it came from (make/model/year) and the engine code/variant.
Send a short video showing the engine being started (or compression test results) and confirm whether it is complete (list included parts).
